historical_verdict_policy: C6-C8 historical returned_facts=0 are NOT backfilled: those batches had zero task-context invocations (C6) or zero MCP invocations (C7-B/C7-D/C8-B), so their adoption conclusions are unchanged; P0/P0b verdicts remain as recorded
mismatch_root_cause: frozen normalize_trace reads payload['facts'] which does not exist in the real runtime payload; fact_ids live inside primary_targets/source_spans/relations/candidates — hence raw facts > 0 while normalized facts = 0

new_mapping_rules.dedup_rule: first occurrence in the fixed section order wins; all sections where the fact_id appeared are recorded in 'sections'
new_mapping_rules.ingestion_rule: only dict payloads with version == 'task-context-v0' AND status == 'available' yield facts
new_mapping_rules.item_rule: a section item is a fact iff it carries a non-empty string fact_id; items without fact_id are skipped (not facts)
new_mapping_rules.legacy_strictness: facts[] items lacking fact_id still raise FormalDataError (backward fail-closed)
new_mapping_rules.no_id_generation: no semantic fact_id is ever synthesized; ids are byte-identical to runtime output
new_mapping_rules.shape_compatibility: returned_facts entries keep {fact_id, payload, returned_sequence}; record-level returned_fact_ids projection unchanged
new_mapping_rules.wiring: future formal runners must call normalize_trace_v2; the frozen normalize_trace and all historical runners are untouched (wiring happens with the next batch task)

old_normalization_contract.rule: for each tool_result payload dict with version == 'task-context-v0', read ONLY the top-level 'facts' array; raise if a facts item lacks fact_id

fact_bearing_sections.candidates: empty in P0b fixtures; covered by the same section rule
fact_bearing_sections.relations: empty in P0b fixtures; covered by the same section rule

non_fact_sections.expansion_handles: items carry symbol_id/command only (no fact_id) — handles for further queries, excluded by rule

real_runtime_schema.output_format_note: task-context emits JSON only with --json; default output is Python repr (P0 finding)
real_runtime_schema.source: D9-C9-P0b archived raw tool responses (verbatim fixtures copied into fixtures/)
real_runtime_schema.status_lifecycle: not_built (before index) -> not_found (absent symbol) / available (facts present)
